reviews.comment: The material is difficult and takes some effort to grasp, but the exams and assignments are pretty straight forward. Nothing will make sense unless you go to the lectures and take good notes. The class is sometimes confusing but the prof and TA are very available outside of class for questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 2 exams w/ 1 final, 10 pop-quizzes (can use notes and slides), 2 hws, 1 lab project w/ good instructions. He's passionate, just not the best at explaining but willing to re-explain until you get it. Gives review slides before exams w/ topics he expects you to know and its pretty accurate to the test. Challenging, but useful material. Also nice TA.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Here I am studying for the final. Despite attending all of the lectures and attempting to write notes over everything said... I find myself realizing I have learned close to nothing! This class is fast-paced and unless you have a strong background in genomics already, nothing makes sense and it is just him spewing sounds of nonsense over graphs.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: had to q-drop after first exam. I didnt come to class much which is on me. But the days i did, I didn't understand anyways. 3 exams, 2 HWs, 10 pop quizzes, 1 lab report. was abel to get some extra credit at start of semester. Recommend going to class if possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Recording his lectures is helpful as there is not much info on the ppt slides. You have to come to class to be succesful. TA for lab is very helpful and approachable.Very fun lab but lecture is confusing and taught like a graduate class. I will probably have to q-drop. Fast paced lectures and multiple unanswered questions.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although leeway should be given considering this is the first semester of this class in several years, the instruction has been subpar. There is no textbook. However, due to the limited information and instruction given at an incomprehensible level, a textbook would be beneficial. Background is needed for this course to be successful.
